page.notes: Right margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 19, 25, 30 and 35 are line numbers printed in the margin; their exact lines are approximate, and no 20 is clearly visible. "At" followed by a small mark near the margin may be a reference or a line number; it is copied as "At" with the note 35, which is doubtful. "Iudâ" and "Babylonicâ" with circumflex, and "7o" and "2o" written with a letter o, are copied as the scan shows them and may be misread.
